title: 第3章 祝……安息

第3章 祝……安息
“此物……”
许青眼睛里露出强烈的光芒，脑海浮现出在紫水晶没有被自己拿走前，那具完好无损的尸体。
“可让尸身完好，可让活人伤势急速痊愈？”
许青一把握住手中的紫色水晶，心脏快跳中飞速看向四周。
尽管他知晓此地应该没有其他活人，可还是因获得至宝，本能的有所警惕。
此刻更是不再停留，而是全速疾驰，直奔自身躲藏的地洞。
途中他隐隐发现，自己的伤势不但飞速愈合，更是就连身体的疲惫，似乎也都少了很多。
以往他如此奔跑，大约半个时辰就需要缓一下，但如今早已过了半个时辰，他觉得全身暖洋洋，体力似还充沛。
甚至他回来的路上，还顺手抓了一只落下的飞禽。
没有杀死，而是将其弄昏，因为活物的保存时间更久。
即便做了这些，他回地洞的时间，也还是缩减了很多。距离黑夜还有一些时，他就已经遥遥的看到了自己的地洞。
许青的心情，前所未有的好了起来，但他没有疏忽大意。
因为他知道，或许是神灵睁眼，禁区初成的缘故，这片范围在夜晚时，除了异兽苏醒，还会有一些诡异的存在出现。
他在贫民窟中听人说过，知道天地间，很多死亡居多的地方，会形成这种诡异。
如夜晚时外面传来的笑声，就是这一类存在发出。
而对于这种异类，公认是勿看、勿触、勿遇。
虽他之前经历，那些存在都是在夜晚出现，但许青也不确定，它们会不会在白天偶尔出没。
于是他的速度丝毫不减，很快就临近地洞，一闪钻入后，将地洞的裂缝堵住。
随后他盘膝坐下，

紫色的光从他掌心散开，将这小小的地洞映照，在那光芒下许青的面孔与眼睛，也都被渲染成了紫色。
他目不转睛，凝望手心内的紫色水晶。
这水晶长条形，与他手指差不多大，其内似有一些絮状之物，而紫色的光，正是那些絮状物发出。
“愈合伤口么……”许青观察许久，解开衣衫看向自己胸口伤痕，发现伤口已经愈合了九成。
如今剩下的部分，似用不了太久，便可以彻底痊愈，甚至连周围的疤痕都在消散。
再联想自己一路跑回，比以往少了很多的疲惫感，许青已经内心初步对这紫色水晶有了大致的判断。
此物的作用，显而易见就是恢复。
恢复伤势，恢复体力，恢复生机！
“不知还有没有其他的功效。”许青喃喃，目中露出思索。
他不知道这紫色水晶是否与神灵睁开眼有关，但大概率应是如此。
可无论如何，这是一个至宝，最起码许青从小到大，还从没听说过有什么物品，能有如此惊人的恢复力。
这样的物品放在身边，对其自身的帮助等于是第二条命。
但许青很清楚，如今自身能拥有此物，是因这城池内除了自己没有其他活人。
而一旦血雨结束，自己走出去后……这样的宝物，他恐怕无力保护。
所以唯一的方法，就是将这紫色水晶藏起来……
许青沉吟半晌，看了眼被自己抓回来的那只昏迷的飞禽，抬手将其一把取来。
捏住嘴喙使其无法发出声音后，他抽出小腿上的匕首，直接在飞禽身上豁开一道伤痕。
在这飞禽挣扎中，许青将那紫色水晶塞了进去。
随后眼睛不眨一下密切关注。
只见这飞禽一开始还在挣扎，但很快这四周就有暗流涌动。灵能仿佛被吸引而来，甚至比许青修炼时涌现的灵能都要多了不少，直奔这飞禽体内。

而此禽挣扎的力度，竟也瞬间比之前强了很多，许青的力道与其比较，似都有些抓不住。
这一幕，让许青目中光芒大盛。
往日一把就可捏碎的飞禽脖子，此刻他用力捏了数次，才将其捏断。
飞快从其体内取出了紫色水晶，将其擦拭一番，他闭目思索。
“飞禽没死，反倒有灵能涌入，且飞禽力气突然变的极大……应该无碍。”
片刻后，许青睁开眼，目中带着果断，直接就将这紫色水晶，塞进了胸膛即将完全愈合的伤口内。
塞入的过程有些痛，但许青咬牙忍受。
没有什么比藏在自己身体里，更安全的地方了。
而他也简单验证过，此物放在身体内，似乎效果会更好。
随着紫色水晶的融入，随着他胸口伤势的愈合，没等许青仔细查看，他体内就传来轰鸣声。
一股比之前飞禽所吸引之力还要更为磅礴的灵能，直接就从四面八方，穿透泥土向着他这里呼啸而来。
这灵能太过惊人，许青的身体刹那就翻起了淡青色，无法形容的冰寒弥漫全身。
这是灵能内的异质太浓所导致。
但许青早有准备，此刻毫不迟疑直接就运转海山诀。
随着运转，涌入他体内的灵能骤然间被分离出大量的异质。
余下的纯净灵能顺着他全身经脉，流淌全身，使得许青的身体在这一刻，发出了砰砰之声。
就仿佛体内的一些淤塞之处，被瞬间
他的脑海里所观想的魈图，在这一刻也仿佛活了一样，自行的摆出各种姿势。
海山诀，虽是修行功法，但它不是修法，而是炼体一类。
共分为十层，对应凝气境的十层。

竹简上对其有清晰介绍，每一层可让修行者增加一虎之力，而五虎为一魈，二魈为一魁。
号称魈可搬山，魁能移海，所以才被命名为海山诀。
此刻，他胸口埋入体内的紫色水晶，就好似一个漩涡，不断的吸撤下，灵能如灌顶般到来。
许青的修炼速度也随之暴增。
不知过去了多久，他体内的砰砰声骤然强烈，大量的体内杂质，顺着他全身汗毛孔流出。
一股腥臭的味道也弥漫在了地洞内。
而随着杂质的流出，许青的身体竟变得晶莹不少，被污垢遮盖的面孔，此刻也越发清秀。
直至半晌过去，随着其体内声响与涌入灵能的逐渐消失，许青双眼猛地睁开。
他的目中竟有紫色的光一闪而逝。
恢复正常后，许青神色呆了一下。
漆黑的地洞此刻在他眼中，居然变得清晰了一些，他连忙低头查看自身，神色渐渐露出无法置信。
“这种感觉……”
许青神色带着一丝激动，站起一拳打出，竟掀起尖锐的风声。
因地洞很小，所以他无法尝试速度，但抬腿与出拳的感觉，让他知道自己比曾经，在各方面都得到了惊人的提升。
随后他立刻撸起左臂上的衣袖。
当看到小臂上出现了一个指甲盖大小的黑点后，许青深吸口气，将心底的激动压下。
“原来，这就是凝气一层！”
这黑点，按照竹简上描述，就是异化点，海山诀的异化点是在左臂上，每一层增加一个。
摸了摸手臂上的异化点，许青此刻心中更多的还是对于自身明显强大起来的振奋，于是他抬头看向缝隙入口，心底琢磨着等天亮了，去试试速度。
但很快许青就神色惊疑，靠近缝隙入口，仔细去听。

外界，明明还是漆黑，可却一丁点的异常声音都没有。
这是他在这里多日来，从未遇到过的。
以往就算是天亮后，没有了异兽与诡异之音，可雨声是无时无刻不存在的。
可现在雨水的声音，也都没有了。
“难道……”
许青心神一震，有一个猜测浮现心底。
默默等待中，直至有一束耀眼的光，顺着地洞的入口缝隙照耀进来，映入许青漆黑的眼眸中，仿佛点亮了他的世界。
在看到光的一刻，许青身体明显的抖了一下。
他抬起手，慢慢的靠近那缕阳光，置入其中，将阳光捧在手心，久违的温暖，慢慢唤醒他沉睡的心灵。
“阳光……”
半晌后，许青眼睛里露出明亮的神采，推开堵着缝隙的杂物，随着更多的光束拥抱而来，他缓缓的钻了出去。
在从出口探身走出的一瞬，他抬起头，看到的不再是浓密阴暗的云层，而是明亮灿烂的太阳。
仿佛晨曦中的老人，在病重了多日后，重新焕发了生机，徐徐拉开了序幕，将清新再次降临了人间。
“雨，停了。”
许青深深的呼吸了一口蕴含了阳光的空气，默默的望着这座朝霞掩映下的城池。
城池内的一切，在这夺目的红日下，似也都郁勃出了一些不一样的光彩。
天边的鲜红朝霞，从云缝里照射下来，像无数条鲸鱼喷吐着金色的瀑布，将满城的阴霾雾气一点点的冲刷开，露出了斑驳的伤痕。
那一处处坍塌的屋舍，一具具青黑色的尸体，一处处触目惊心的血色水洼，似乎都在提醒着许青，这里发生的浩劫。
许青目中露出一抹复杂，他在城池外的贫民窟，生活了六年，这座城池，他也一样看了六年。
虽进来的次数不多，但这里，是他曾经这六年中，最渴望能去居住的地方。

“我在这里获得了修行的功法。”
“我在这里得到了紫色水晶。”
“我在这里……活了下来。”许青喃喃，沉默。
直至许久他轻叹一声，迈步走到一处青黑色的尸体旁，低头看了半晌，将其背了起来，向前走去。
一路走到了附近的一处广场上，他才将尸体放下，然后转身，背第二具，第三具，第四具……
一些尸体，散落在街头，还有一些压在废墟下。
直至他将这附近区域的所有尸体，都背到了广场后，这里的尸骸堆积如山，有的完整，有的残缺。
许青站在那里，放了一把火，或许是异质的缘故，火焰越烧越烈，冒起浓烟……
在那浓烟中，许青看了许久，默默走远，去了第二处区域，很快的，又一处浓烟升起，越来越多……越来越多……
就这样，在阳光映入这片废墟城池的第一天，城池内除了光，还有尸体火化的黑色浓烟。
这黑烟一道道升空，遮盖了阳光，晨曦也在这一刻，充满了无力，变的昏红，好似藏着深深的叹息。
似乎，那一道道浓烟，成为了它的眼泪。而地面上形成的一条条倒影，仿佛化作了大地的泪痕。
最后一处泪痕，是许青发现紫光的地方。
在那里，许青将药铺老人的尸体放下，随着尸堆火焰的焚烧，热浪拂面，他默默站在火堆旁，滚滚火焰映照在他漆黑的瞳孔中，不断地摇晃。
枯乱的长发也因热浪的弥漫而弯曲，半晌后，许青的身体一样弯曲，低头一拜。
“祝……安息。”
火焰在这一刻，猛然剧烈的燃烧，越来越烈，散出无数好似蒲公英一样的火苗，随风飘散。
只是那袅袅升空的浓烟，依旧带着逝者无法消融的不甘与遗憾，风也无法吹散。
越升越高，如苍穹上的几缕伤痕。
微不足道，满是无奈。

许久，伴随着杂乱的脚步声，一个阴阳怪调的声音，在少年身后的远处，突然的传来。
“我说怎么一路走来，没有看见尸体，原来是有这么一个傻小子，不惜耗费自身体力，居然把尸体搬到这里火化。”
“也罢，既然你如此留恋，那么我就帮你一下，把你扔进去陪他们一起好了。”
许青骤然转身。
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 3 Rest in peace...
"This thing..."
Xu Qing's eyes showed a strong light, and the intact corpse before the amethyst was taken away by him appeared in his mind.
"Can the body be kept intact and the injuries of the living be healed quickly?"
Xu Qing grabbed the purple crystal in his hand and looked around quickly with his heart beating fast.
Although he knew that there should be no other living people here, he was still instinctively wary because he had obtained the treasure.
At this moment, he no longer stopped, but galloped at full speed, heading straight for the cave where he was hiding.
On the way, he faintly discovered that not only did his injuries heal quickly, but his physical fatigue seemed to be reduced a lot.
In the past, he would need to slow down after running like this for about half an hour, but now that half an hour had passed, he felt warm all over his body and seemed to still have plenty of energy.
He even caught a fallen bird on his way back.
Instead of killing, they stun them because living things last longer.
Even after doing this, the time he had to return to the cave was still shortened a lot. When it was still dark, he could already see his cave in the distance.
Xu Qing's mood was better than ever, but he was not careless.
Because he knew that perhaps because the gods opened their eyes and the restricted area was first formed, in this area at night, in addition to the awakening of strange beasts, there would also be some strange beings appearing.
He had heard people say it in the slums and knew that there were many places where death was common in the world, and this kind of weirdness would occur.
For example, the laughter coming from outside at night is caused by this type of existence.
As for such aliens, it is generally accepted that they should not be seen, touched, or encountered.
Although he had experienced that those entities appeared at night, Xu Qing was not sure whether they would occasionally appear during the day.
So his speed did not slow down at all, and he quickly approached the cave. After diving in, he blocked the cracks in the cave.
Then he sat down cross-legged,
Purple light spread out from his palm, reflecting the small hole in the ground. Under the light, Xu Qing's face and eyes were also rendered purple.
He stared intently at the purple crystal in his palm.
This crystal was long in shape, about the same size as his finger, and there seemed to be some flocculent matter inside it, and the purple light was emitted from those flocculent matter.
"Healing the wound..." Xu Qing observed for a long time, took off his clothes and looked at the scar on his chest, and found that the wound was 90% healed.
Now, it seems that the remaining part will be completely healed in a short time, and even the surrounding scars are dissipating.
Recalling that he was much less tired than before when he ran all the way back, Xu Qing had already made a rough judgment about the purple crystal.
The function of this thing is obviously to restore.
Recover injuries, regain strength, and regain vitality!
"I wonder if there are any other effects." Xu Qing murmured, thinking in his eyes.
He didn't know if the purple crystal was related to the opening of the gods' eyes, but it was most likely so.
But no matter what, this is a treasure. At least since Xu Qing was a child, he has never heard of any item that can have such amazing recovery power.
Keeping such items by your side can help you, which is like a second life.
But Xu Qing knew very well that he could possess this thing now because there was no other living person in the city except himself.
And once the bloody rain ends, after he walks out...he may not be able to protect such a treasure.
So the only way is to hide this purple crystal...
Xu Qing pondered for a long time, looked at the unconscious bird that he had captured, and raised his hand to take it out.
After pinching the beak to make it unable to make a sound, he took out the dagger on his calf and opened a wound directly on the bird's body.
While the bird was struggling, Xu Qing stuffed the purple crystal inside.
Then pay close attention without blinking.
I saw this bird at the beginningHe was still struggling, but soon there was an undercurrent surging around him. The spiritual energy seemed to be attracted, and it was even much more than the spiritual energy that emerged during Xu Qing's practice, and went straight into the bird's body.
The strength of the bird's struggle was suddenly much stronger than before. Compared with Xu Qing's strength, it seemed that he could not catch it.
This scene made Xu Qing's eyes shine brightly.
In the past, the bird's neck could be crushed with just one handful, but now he squeezed it hard several times before breaking it.
He quickly took out the purple crystal from his body, wiped it, and closed his eyes to think.
"The bird is not dead, but there is an influx of spiritual energy, and the bird's strength suddenly becomes extremely strong...it should be fine."
After a moment, Xu Qing opened his eyes, with determination in his eyes, and directly stuffed the purple crystal into the wound on his chest that was about to be completely healed.
The insertion process was a little painful, but Xu Qing gritted his teeth and endured it.
There is no safer place than hiding inside your own body.
And he has also simply verified that if this thing is placed in the body, it seems to have better effects.
As the purple crystal blended in, and as the injury on his chest healed, before Xu Qing could take a closer look, a roar came from his body.
A spiritual energy that was even more majestic than what the birds had attracted before came roaring toward him from all directions, penetrating the soil.
This spiritual power was so amazing that Xu Qing's body instantly turned light blue, and an indescribable coldness filled his whole body.
This is caused by too much heterogeneity within the psychic energy.
But Xu Qing had already prepared, and immediately started using the Haishan Jue without any hesitation.
With the operation, the spiritual energy that poured into his body was suddenly separated into a large number of heterogeneous components.
The remaining pure spiritual energy flowed throughout his body along his meridians, causing Xu Qing's body to make a banging sound at this moment.
It was as if some stagnant places in the body were instantly
The mandrill picture he visualized in his mind seemed to come alive at this moment, assuming various postures on its own.
Although Haishan Jue is a cultivation method, it is not a cultivation method, but a type of body training.
It is divided into ten levels, corresponding to the ten levels of Qi Condensation Realm.
There is a clear introduction to it on the bamboo slips. Each layer can allow the practitioner to increase the power of one tiger, and five tigers are one mandrill, and two mandrills are one leader.
It is said that Mandrill can move mountains, and Kui can move seas, so it is named Haishan Jue.
At this moment, the purple crystal buried in his chest was like a whirlpool, constantly sucking in and out, and the spiritual energy came like an initiation.
Xu Qing's cultivation speed also increased dramatically.
I don't know how much time passed, but the thumping sound in his body suddenly became strong, and a large amount of impurities in his body flowed out from the sweat pores all over his body.
A fishy smell also filled the cave.
As the impurities flowed out, Xu Qing's body became much more crystal clear, and his face covered by dirt became more and more delicate at this moment.
After half a while, Xu Qing's eyes suddenly opened as the sounds and the incoming spiritual energy in his body gradually disappeared.
There was a flash of purple light in his eyes.
After returning to normal, Xu Qing looked stunned for a moment.
The dark hole actually became clearer in his eyes at this moment. He quickly lowered his head to check himself, his expression gradually showing disbelief.
"This feeling..."
Xu Qing looked a little excited, stood up and punched, causing a sharp sound.
Because the cave was very small, he couldn't try his speed, but the feeling of lifting his legs and punching made him know that he had improved astonishingly in all aspects compared to before.
Then he immediately rolled up the sleeve on his left arm.
When he saw a black spot the size of a fingernail appeared on his forearm, Xu Qing took a deep breath and suppressed the excitement in his heart.
"It turns out that this is the first level of Qi Condensation!"
This black spot, according to the description on the bamboo slip, is the alienation point. The alienation point of Haishan Jue is on the left arm, and one is added at each level.
Touching the alienation point on his arm, Xu Qing was more excited about his apparent strength at this moment, so heHe looked up at the entrance of the gap, thinking in his mind to wait until daybreak to test his speed.
But soon Xu Qing looked suspicious, approached the entrance of the gap, and listened carefully.
The outside world was still dark, but there was no unusual sound at all.
This was something he had never encountered in the many days he had been here.
In the past, even after dawn, there were no strange beasts and strange sounds, but the sound of rain was always present.
But now the sound of rain has disappeared.
"Could it be..."
Xu Qing's mind was shaken, and a guess emerged in his mind.
Waiting silently, until a dazzling light shone through the crack at the entrance of the cave, reflected in Xu Qing's dark eyes, and seemed to light up his world.
The moment Xu Qing saw the light, his body trembled obviously.
He raised his hand, slowly approached the ray of sunshine, placed it in it, and held it in his palm. The long-lost warmth slowly awakened his sleeping soul.
"Sunshine..."
After a while, Xu Qing's eyes showed a bright look, he pushed aside the debris blocking the gap, and as more beams of light embraced him, he slowly got out.
The moment he leaned out of the exit, he raised his head and saw no longer dense and dark clouds, but a bright and brilliant sun.
As if the old man in the morning light has regained his vitality after being seriously ill for many days, slowly kicking off the show, bringing freshness to the world again.
"The rain has stopped."
Xu Qing took a deep breath of the air filled with sunshine and silently looked at the city covered by the morning glow.
Everything in the city seemed to have a different brilliance under the dazzling red sun.
The bright red morning glow on the horizon shines down from the gaps in the clouds, like countless whales spewing golden waterfalls, washing away the haze and fog in the city bit by bit, revealing the mottled scars.
The collapsed houses, the blue-black corpses, and the shocking blood-colored puddles everywhere seemed to remind Xu Qing of the catastrophe that had occurred here.
There was a hint of complexity in Xu Qing's eyes. He had lived in the slums outside the city for six years, and he had also watched this city for the same six years.
Although he didn't come in often, this was the place he had longed to live most in the past six years.
"I gained the skills to practice here."
"I got the purple crystal here."
"I'm here...survived." Xu Qing murmured, silent.
After a long while, he sighed softly, walked to a green-black corpse, looked down at it for a long time, picked it up on his back, and walked forward.
After walking all the way to a nearby square, he put the body down, then turned around and carried the second, third, and fourth bodies on his back...
Some bodies were scattered on the streets, and some were buried under the rubble.
Until he carried all the corpses in the nearby area to the back of the square, where the corpses piled up like mountains, some complete and some incomplete.
Xu Qing stood there and set a fire. Perhaps due to the abnormality, the flames burned stronger and stronger, and thick smoke rose...
Xu Qing looked at the thick smoke for a long time, then silently walked away to the second area. Soon, another thick smoke rose, more and more... more and more...
Just like this, on the first day when the sun shone into this ruined city, in addition to the light, there was also thick black smoke from the cremation of corpses in the city.
The black smoke rose into the sky one after another, covering the sun. At this moment, the morning light was also full of powerlessness and turned dim, as if it was hiding a deep sigh.
It seemed that the thick smoke had become its tears. The reflections formed on the ground seemed to turn into tears on the earth.
The last tear stain is where Xu Qing discovered the purple light.
There, Xu Qing put down the body of the old man in the medicine shop. As the flames burned in the pile of corpses, heat waves hit his face. He stood silently by the fire, and the rolling flames reflected in his dark pupils, shaking constantly.
dry long hairIt was also bent due to the heat wave. After a while, Xu Qing's body also bent and bowed his head.
“RIP….”
At this moment, the flames burned suddenly and violently, becoming more and more intense, emitting countless dandelion-like flames that drifted in the wind.
But the thick smoke rising into the sky still carries the unwillingness and regret of the deceased that cannot be melted away, and the wind cannot blow it away.
Rising higher and higher, like a few scars on the sky.
Insignificant and full of helplessness.
After a long time, along with the sound of chaotic footsteps, a strange voice suddenly came from far behind the young man.
"I asked why I didn't see any corpses along the way. It turned out that there was such a stupid boy who, at the expense of his own strength, actually moved the corpse here to be cremated."
"Well, since you are so nostalgic, I will help you and throw you in to accompany them."
Xu Qing turned around suddenly.
